query: select table_name, count(*) as column_count from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name in ('study_accounts','study_profiles','study_sessions','study_settings','piece_types','user_pieces','piece_transactions','audit_logs','catalog_achievements','catalog_titles') group by table_name order by table_name limit 20; select schemaname, tablename, count(*) as policy_count from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('study_accounts','study_profiles','study_sessions','study_settings','piece_types','user_pieces','piece_transactions','audit_logs','catalog_achievements','catalog_titles') group by schemaname, tablename order by tablename limit 20
